name: Acid Splash
description: Hurl acid at one creature, or two creatures close together. Targets make Dexterity saves or take acid damage that scales with character level.

area.size: one creature, or two creatures within 5 feet of each other

name: Acid Splash
description: Create an acidic burst at a point in range. Creatures in a 5-foot-radius sphere make Dexterity saves or take acid damage that scales with character level.

name: Blade Ward
description: Until the end of your next turn, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

name: Blade Ward
description: Protect yourself with magic. While concentrating, attack rolls made against you are reduced by 1d4.

name: Chill Touch
description: Make a ranged spell attack with a spectral hand. On a hit, the target takes necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points until your next turn; undead also have difficulty attacking you.

conditions.duration: until the start of your next turn
until the end of your next turn

name: Chill Touch
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you touch. On a hit, it takes necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

conditions.duration: until the end of your next turn

name: Dancing Lights
description: Create up to four small lights, or combine them into a vaguely humanoid glowing form. You can move the lights while concentrating.

data.material: A bit of phosphorus, wychwood, or a glowworm

name: Dancing Lights
description: Create up to four hovering lights or combine them into one glowing humanoid-sized form. You can move them with a Bonus Action while concentrating.

name: Druidcraft
description: Create one small nature-themed magical effect, such as predicting nearby weather, making a flower bloom, producing a harmless sensory effect, or lighting or snuffing a small flame.

name: Druidcraft
description: Create a minor nature effect, such as a harmless sensory sign, causing a plant to bloom, changing a small natural feature, or creating another simple druidic effect.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: Fire one or more beams of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack for each beam; a hit deals force damage. Additional beams are gained at higher levels.

mechanics.higher_levels: Additional beams at character levels 5, 11, and 17; each beam uses a separate attack roll.

name: Elementalism
description: Create one small elemental effect involving air, earth, fire, or water, such as a breeze, dust effect, harmless flame or smoke, or a small amount of water.

name: Fire Bolt
description: Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit it deals fire damage that scales with character level.

name: Friends
description: For up to 1 minute, gain advantage on Charisma checks directed at one creature that is not hostile to you. When the spell ends, the creature realizes magic influenced it.

data.material: A small amount of makeup applied to the face

conditions.effect: target becomes aware of magical influence

name: Friends
description: Target a humanoid you can see. It makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it is Charmed by you for the duration, with limits on repeated use.

name: Guidance
description: Touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can add 1d4 to one ability check.

name: Guidance
description: Touch a willing creature. While you concentrate, it can add 1d4 to an ability check as allowed by the spell.

name: Light
description: Touch one object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. It sheds bright and dim light for 1 hour and can be covered to block the light.

name: Light
description: Touch one Large or smaller object. It emits bright and dim light for 1 hour; casting the spell again ends the previous instance.

name: Mage Hand
description: Create a spectral floating hand that can manipulate objects, open unlocked containers, stow or retrieve items, and carry up to 10 pounds.

name: Mage Hand
description: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate nearby objects and carry a small amount of weight. You can control it with subsequent actions.

name: Mending
description: Repair a single break or tear in an object you touch, provided the damage is small enough for the spell to mend.

name: Message
description: Point toward a creature in range and whisper a short message only it can hear; it can whisper a reply that only you hear.

data.material: A short piece of copper wire

name: Message
description: Send a whispered message to a creature in range; the target can reply privately. The magic can pass around some obstacles but is blocked by sufficient material.

name: Minor Illusion
description: Create either a sound or an image of an object within range. The illusion lasts up to 1 minute and can be discovered by physical interaction or investigation.

name: Minor Illusion
description: Create a sound or a simple visual illusion within range. Creatures can determine it is illusory through interaction or successful examination.

name: Poison Spray
description: Project poisonous gas at a nearby creature. It makes a Constitution save or takes poison damage that scales with character level.

name: Poison Spray
description: Launch toxic magic at a creature in range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes poison damage that scales with character level.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Produce one of several minor magical tricks, such as a harmless sensory effect, lighting or snuffing a small flame, cleaning or soiling an object, warming or flavoring material, marking a surface, or creating a tiny trinket.

name: Prestidigitation
description: Perform a minor magical trick, including simple sensory effects, cleaning or soiling, lighting or extinguishing a small flame, changing flavor or temperature, making a mark, or creating a tiny temporary object.

name: Produce Flame
description: A flame appears in your hand, giving light. You can also throw it at a creature with a ranged spell attack to deal fire damage.

name: Produce Flame
description: Create a harmless flame in your hand that sheds light. You can make a ranged spell attack with it to deal fire damage that scales with character level.

name: Ray of Frost
description: Fire a freezing beam at a creature. On a hit it takes cold damage and its speed is reduced until the start of your next turn.

conditions.duration: until the start of your next turn

name: Resistance
description: Touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can add 1d4 to one saving throw.

name: Resistance
description: Touch a willing creature and protect it with magic. While you concentrate, it can add 1d4 to a saving throw as allowed by the spell.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Radiance descends on a creature you can see. It makes a Dexterity save or takes radiant damage that scales with character level.

name: Shillelagh
description: Empower a club or quarterstaff. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability for its attack and damage rolls and its damage die becomes d8.

data.material: Mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff

conditions.effect: use spellcasting ability for attack and damage rolls

name: Shillelagh
description: Empower a club or quarterstaff, using your spellcasting ability for attacks and damage. Its damage die improves as you gain levels.

conditions.effect: use spellcasting ability for attack and damage rolls

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Make a melee spell attack that deals lightning damage. A target wearing metal armor gives you advantage, and a hit prevents the target from taking reactions until its next turn.

conditions.duration: until the start of its next turn

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Make a melee spell attack that deals lightning damage. On a hit, the target cannot make opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn.

conditions.duration: until the start of its next turn

name: Sorcerous Burst
description: Launch sorcerous energy at a creature or object. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit it deals damage of a chosen type, with a chance for additional damage dice.

damage.type: chosen: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, psychic, or thunder

mechanics.higher_levels: If you roll an 8 on a damage die, you can roll an additional d8, subject to the spell's maximum number of extra dice.

name: Spare the Dying
description: Touch a living creature at 0 hit points to stabilize it.

name: Spare the Dying
description: Stabilize a creature in range that has 0 hit points. The spell's range increases as you gain levels.

mechanics.higher_levels: Range increases at higher character levels.

name: Starry Wisp
description: Launch a mote of light at a creature or object. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit it deals radiant damage and makes the target emit dim light until your next turn.

conditions.duration: until the end of your next turn

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Create one of several minor divine manifestations, such as amplifying your voice, altering flames, causing harmless tremors or sounds, or opening an unlocked door or window.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: Create a minor supernatural sign such as an altered voice, an unusual sensory effect, a harmless environmental disturbance, or another simple divine manifestation.

name: Thorn Whip
description: Create a vine-like whip and make a melee spell attack against a creature in range. A hit deals piercing damage and can pull a Large or smaller target closer.

data.material: The stem of a plant with thorns

name: True Strike
description: On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against a chosen target, provided the spell has not ended.

conditions.effect: advantage on first attack roll against chosen target

name: True Strike
description: Make one attack with a weapon used in the spell's casting, using your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage. The attack can deal radiant damage and gains extra damage at higher levels.

data.material: A weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

conditions.effect: use spellcasting ability for attack and damage rolls

name: Vicious Mockery
description: Insult a creature you can see. It makes a Wisdom save or takes psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

conditions.duration: before end of target's next turn

name: Vicious Mockery
description: Unleash a magically laced insult. The target makes a Wisdom save or takes psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

conditions.duration: before end of target's next turn
